إِمْلَاجَةٌ A single act of suckling. (TA.) ―
-b2- It is said in a trad., لا تُحَرِّمُ الإِمْلَاجَةُ وَلَا الإِمْلَاجَتَانِ, (S,) i. e. One act of suckling, or the giving one such, does not bar [the two parties from marrying each other], nor do two acts of suckling, or the giving two sucks, like as complete suckling does. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
